title: Flappy Ascent
description: One-button ascent through procedurally spaced gates across six parallax sky zones. Thread drifting, narrowing and shuttering gates for bronze, silver and gold medals, chase your personal-best ghost, and climb a seeded 80-gate Daily Ascent to the summit.

achievements.title: Rising Star
achievements.desc: Pass 10 gates in a single run.

achievements.title: Cloudbreaker
achievements.desc: Pass 25 gates in a single run.

achievements.title: Stratosphere
achievements.desc: Pass 50 gates in a single run.
